about: R2 task fields pinned per card version. Copied from rule book v1 amendment 1, section 4 (founder ruling 52c), pillar docs/evals/RULEBOOK-V1-AMENDMENT-1-2026-11-24.md, pillar commit a82c28f. A task cannot choose these values; the task builder takes them from here and refuses a caller value that differs. This file changes only when a new rule book amendment changes that table.
